evidence.statement: The frozen blind CANDIDATE-0002 contains a 17-bp direct-orientation block TCTTCTTCACCACCGGT at E. coli start0 3,070,693 and yeast start0 326,936.
Post-freeze annotation places this block at coding start0 534 in both fbaA and FBA1; it begins on a codon boundary in both implementations.
In coding orientation the block is ACCGGTGGTGAAGAAGA; five complete codons encode TGGEE.
This is a second independent conserved coding primitive inside the same validated aldolase module.

semantics.validated_identity: coding fragment within homologous class-II fructose-bisphosphate aldolase genes

unknowns: Specific mechanistic role of the exact TGGEE-preserving segment.
